project.name: ExcelPro Washers Website
project.description: Full-stack Next.js 16 business website and CRM for ExcelPro Washers — an exterior cleaning company in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. Includes AI lead qualification, multi-portal architecture (Admin/Sales/Contractor), Stripe payments, Twilio voice/SMS, Resend email automation, semantic search with pgvector, and automated follow-up sequences.

db.ts.description: 562-line Supabase-backed database layer. Provides CRUD operations for all entities (clients, jobs, quotes, invoices, requests, users, contractorApplications) with automatic camelCase↔snake_case field mapping. Uses Supabase JS client.

supabase.ts.description: Supabase client initialization with SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY environment variables. Falls back to placeholder key during build.

leads.ts.description: Lead-specific database layer for lead_requests, lead_quotes, lead_follow_ups, and lead_ai_feedback tables. Provides getAll, getById, create, update, getStats, getStale operations.

subscribers.ts.description: Subscriber and campaign management for email marketing. Tables: email_subscribers, email_campaigns. Operations: subscribe, unsubscribe, getActive, getStats + campaign CRUD.

voice.ts.description: Voice system database layer for call_conversations, call_logs, and voice_bookings tables with CRUD + stats.

LeadQualifier.ts.description: 424-line AI lead qualification engine using Anthropic Claude Haiku. Weighted scoring: urgency (35%), budget fit (25%), authority (25%), project value (15%). Categories: HOT (80-100), WARM (50-79), COLD (<50). Includes fallback rule-based scoring if API fails. Generates personalized price-range quotes.

LeadRouter.ts.description: Orchestrator that routes qualified leads to appropriate automation sequences. HOT → instant quote + 24h follow-up. WARM → instant quote + Day 3/7/14 nurture emails. COLD → educational email + Day 7/30/90 nurture + auto-newsletter-subscribe.

WarmLeadSequence.ts.description: Warm lead email nurture sequence manager. Executes Day 3 (check-in), Day 7 (special offer with 10% discount code WARMBACK10), Day 14 (final reminder) follow-ups.

ColdLeadSequence.ts.description: Cold lead nurture sequence manager. Executes Day 7 (case study), Day 30 (seasonal offer with SAVE15), Day 90 (re-engagement) follow-ups. Auto-subscribes cold leads to newsletter.

embeddings.ts.description: 303-line semantic search system with pgvector. Uses OpenAI text-embedding-ada-002 for 1536-dim embeddings. Functions: generateEmbedding, upsertEmbedding, semanticSearch, syncAllEmbeddings. Builds searchable text for clients, jobs, leads, and quotes.

mcp-tools.ts.description: 867-line tool definitions for AI Business Advisor. Defines 20+ tools: list_clients, get_client, create_client, update_client, list_jobs, get_job, create_job, update_job, list_quotes, create_quote, list_invoices, create_invoice, list_leads, get_lead, update_lead, convert_lead, search_crm (semantic search), send_email, get_revenue_analytics. Each tool has name, description, input_schema, and execute function.

EmailService.ts.description: 505-line email service using Resend API. Methods: send() (generic), sendInstantQuote() (rich HTML with price range, timeline, and discount code QUICK10), sendEducationalEmail() (soft washing tips), sendFollowUp() (customizable follow-up), sendSpecialOffer() (discount promotion). All emails include CAN-SPAM footer with physical address and unsubscribe link.

NotificationService.ts.description: Multi-channel notification hub. notifyNewLead() sends: console log with detailed breakdown, Resend email (HTML with color-coded priority), Twilio SMS (hot leads only), and Slack webhook (optional). logAIDecision() records AI qualification decisions for performance tracking.

notifications.ts.description: 230-line standalone hot lead notification utilities: sendHotLeadSMS() via Twilio and sendHotLeadEmail() via Resend with HTML template.

InvoicePDF.tsx.description: 353-line React-PDF document for invoice generation. Includes company header with branding, status banners (Paid=green, Overdue=red, Pending=yellow), bill-to section, itemized service details, totals, payment instructions, and footer.

session.ts.description: 106-line HMAC-SHA256 session management. signSession() creates base64-encoded payload with hex signature. verifySession() validates signature integrity. verifyAdminSession() checks for ADMIN role. verifyPortalSession() checks for SALES or CONTRACTOR role. Uses SESSION_SECRET env var (falls back to ADMIN_PASSWORD).

rateLimit.ts.description: In-memory rate limiter with configurable window and max requests. isRateLimited() checks by IP, getClientIp() extracts from headers (x-forwarded-for), rateLimitResponse() returns 429 JSON. Auto-cleanup of expired entries every 5 minutes.

validateEnv.ts.description: Environment variable validation at startup. Required: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY, TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, CRON_SECRET. Recommended: OWNER_EMAIL, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL.

utils.ts.description: cn() utility using clsx + tailwind-merge for conditional Tailwind class composition.

logger.ts.description: 147-line structured logger with levels (debug/info/success/warn/error), ISO timestamps, colored console output. Includes logApi() and logDb() helper methods.

site.ts.description: Centralized business configuration. Exports siteConfig with business name, phone, email, location (Ottawa ON), 5 services with prices, and metadata.

types.ts.description: Complete TypeScript interfaces: Client, Job (with contractor assignment, before/after photos, client signoff), Quote (with line items), Invoice, Request (with AI scoring fields), User, ContractorApplication, AIFeedback, ScheduledFollowUp, CallLog, CallConversation, DbSchema.

leadQualification.description: Every contact form submission is analyzed by Claude Haiku AI. Scores leads 0-100 using weighted criteria (urgency 35%, budget 25%, authority 25%, value 15%). Categorizes as HOT (80-100), WARM (50-79), or COLD (<50). Has fallback rule-based scoring if API fails.

leadRouting.description: After AI scoring, leads are automatically routed to sequences: HOT → instant quote email + 24h follow-up + admin SMS alert. WARM → instant quote + Day 3/7/14 nurture emails. COLD → educational content + Day 7/30/90 re-engagement + auto-subscribe to newsletter.

businessAdvisor.description: Interactive AI chat assistant for admin dashboard. Uses Claude with tool_use to access 20+ CRM operations. Can list/create/update clients, jobs, quotes, invoices, leads. Can perform semantic search across CRM data, send emails, and analyze revenue.

semanticSearch.description: Vector similarity search across CRM data using pgvector. All clients, jobs, leads, and quotes are embedded as 1536-dim vectors using OpenAI ada-002. search_crm SQL function finds most similar records by cosine distance.

voiceReceptionist.description: AI-powered phone receptionist that answers calls 24/7. Greets callers, understands speech via Twilio ASR, responds using Claude AI for natural conversation about services/pricing/scheduling. Uses ElevenLabs for natural-sounding voice (falls back to Amazon Polly). Supports DTMF input, retry logic (max 2 attempts), and voicemail recording.
voiceReceptionist.voiceSynthesis: ElevenLabs (Rachel voice) or Amazon Polly (Joanna, neural)

aiPerformanceMonitoring.description: Dashboard for tracking AI lead qualification accuracy. Admins can rate each AI decision as accurate/inaccurate. Shows total leads analyzed, accuracy rate, average score, hot lead conversion rate, category distribution. Supports CSV export of all decisions.

flow: 1. Admin creates invoice linked to job/client
4. Redirected to Stripe Checkout (hosted payment page)
7. Invoice status auto-updated to 'Paid' in database
8. Customer redirected back to invoice page showing paid status
3. TwiML greeting played via ElevenLabs or Polly TTS
4. Speech recognition gathers caller input (+ DTMF fallback)
6. Claude AI processes speech and generates response
8. Loop continues for conversation (max 2 retries on no input)
9. Falls back to voicemail recording if no response
